query_template: Produce a private-company initiation report on {{company_name}}. Company website: {{website}}. Stage: {{stage}}. Evaluation context: {{evaluation_context}}. Research scope: {{scope}}. Comparable companies: {{peers}}. Key debates to address: {{key_debates}}. Uploaded materials: see the files attached to this turn. Data source: {{data_source}}. Output format: {{output_format}}. Additional context: {{additional_context}}.

fields.label: Company website
fields.placeholder: e.g., stripe.com — helps disambiguate; leave blank to auto-resolve

fields.label: Evaluation context
fields.description: Shapes emphasis (e.g., secondary purchases weight the preference stack and secondary marks more heavily).

options.value: Revenue quality, unit economics, burn & runway
options.label: Revenue quality, unit economics, burn & runway

fields.label: Data sources
fields.description: Select every data provider you want this run to draw on. Providers you have not connected are skipped gracefully and noted, so connecting them enriches the output. Perplexity Finance is always available.

options.label: PitchBook
options.description: Private company rounds, valuations, cap tables, sponsor M&A — requires connected PitchBook

options.label: Perplexity Finance (built-in)
options.description: Always available — live quotes, financials, estimates, transcripts, macro data

options.label: FactSet
options.description: Consensus estimates, fundamentals, ownership, M&A — requires connected FactSet

options.label: Daloopa
options.description: Analyst-grade historical fundamentals and KPIs with filing citations — requires connected Daloopa

options.label: Morningstar
options.description: Fundamentals, fair values, fund and ETF data — requires connected Morningstar

options.label: Carbon Arc (alt data)
options.description: Alternative data: demand and transaction signals to corroborate or challenge reported KPIs — requires connected Carbon Arc

options.label: Guidepoint (expert calls)
options.description: Expert interview transcripts: customers, competitors, former employees — requires connected Guidepoint

fields.label: Comparable companies
fields.placeholder: Public comps and private peers; leave blank for auto-selection

fields.label: Key debates to address
fields.placeholder: 2–4 questions that will determine the outcome, e.g., is reported ARR durable?

fields.label: Upload materials
fields.accept_description: Decks, data-room excerpts, financials, or prior research

fields.label: Additional context
fields.placeholder: e.g., Considering a $5M secondary block at a 20% discount to the last round
